programs.title: Guy's Grocery Games
programs.desc: Guy Fieri brings the international flavors he's discovered back home by inviting four DDD chefs to cook their world cuisine in Flavortown Market; their first challenge is injecting their global flavor into a diner classic.

programs.title: Flavortown Food Fight
programs.desc: Guy Fieri has declared it Fry Day, and the returning champion takes on Jacob Town and Taylor Frankel in an epic battle for golden brown and delicious domination; Judges Mei Lin and Maneet Chauhan decide which chef takes home the gold and up to $20,000.

programs.title: Flavortown Food Fight
programs.desc: Guy Fieri challenges the chefs to a fish-filled food fight as the reigning champ casts their net for more riches against Cristina Topham and Lambert Givens; Judges Jonathon Sawyer and Michael Voltaggio decide who is the winner of this maritime madness.

programs.title: Guy's Grocery Games
programs.sub_title: City Food Fight: Los Angeles vs. San Francisco
programs.desc: Guy Fieri invites culinary duos from Los Angeles and San Francisco to each prepare three-course feasts designed to prove which city's food is best; they use ingredients from both cities in hopes of winning $15,000 and Golden State bragging rights.

programs.title: Guy's Grocery Games
programs.sub_title: City Food Fight: Chicago vs. NYC
programs.desc: Guy brings in chef duos from Chicago and New York to prepare a feast that proves their city's food is world-class; they use ingredients that celebrate The Big Apple and Chicago's The Bean in hopes of scoring $15,000 and big city bragging rights.
